image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a reusable cloth diaper (nappy). The main body is made of a soft, white fleece-like material. It features blue patterned trim along the leg openings and waist, with yellow elastic loops visible at the sides. A small red tag with text is sewn into the lower-left side seam. The diaper appears padded and has gathered ruffles at the leg cuffs due to elastic casing.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object clearly displays the characteristic shape of a diaper with defined leg holes and a waistband area. Elastic gathering is visible at the legs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Thickness is notably padded and bulky when uncompressed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The folds and shadows indicate significant thickness and padding, consistent with an absorbent core.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Folded form shows layered construction with absorbent core between layers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The diaper is assembled/closed, not unfolded to reveal the internal cross-section or layered construction explicitly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Fastening system uses adhesive tabs (hook-and-loop or sticky) on side panels.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: This appears to be a pull-up style or pre-fastened cloth diaper. No adhesive tabs or hook-and-loop fasteners are visible on the exterior; instead, there are yellow elastic loops/straps.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elastic creates gathered ruffles at leg cuffs.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct gathering/ruffling is visible along the inner edge of the leg openings, indicating elastic casing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Size indicators and wetness strip may be visible.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No wetness indicator strip is visible. There is a brand tag, but no specific size indicator markings are clear.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Outer surface is smooth plastic or fabric-like material in white or printed patterns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The outer surface is a white, textured fabric (fleece/microfiber), fitting the 'fabric-like' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Inner surface is soft non-woven fabric.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The inner lining is mostly occluded by the angle and the folded nature of the diaper; only glimpses of the interior are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Absorbent padded core with waterproof outer layer.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While padding is inferred from bulk, the specific 'waterproof' nature of the outer layer cannot be visually verified without tactile interaction or seeing a PUL (polyurethane laminate) sheen, which is absent here (it looks like fleece).

artifact_observations.location: Red tag on the lower-left side
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the small red brand tag is illegible and slightly distorted, typical of AI generation struggling with small text details. It resembles letters but does not form clear words.
The texture is very uniform and slightly 'smudged' in the highlights, lacking the distinct individual fiber definition seen in high-resolution macro photography of fleece. It looks slightly painted.
